newsitem.title: FRANCE: GENERAL UTILITIES TO MEET LEIGH INTERESTS.
newsitem.headline: GENERAL UTILITIES TO MEET LEIGH INTERESTS.

text.p: General Utilities, the British unit of French water company Generale des Eaux, said on Tuesday it would meet UK environmental services group Leigh Interests Plc to discuss the possibility of the two companies moving closer.
"Meetings are due to be held," Gillian Pattison, spokeswoman for General Utilities, told Reuters.
A source close to the planned talks said the meetings could be held either Tuesday or Wednesday.
Leigh Interests confirmed on Monday press reports that it had received an unsolicited approach from General Utilities, but added that it was not clear whether any proposal would be put forward.
General Utilities also confirmed its interest in Leigh, but stressed that talks were only beginning and would not necessarily lead to an offer.
Shares in Leigh jumped 23 percent in London after the news broke on Monday and ended Tuesday's trading at 145 pence, down 2 pence from the open.
